# DevRel Video Performance Analysis

## Top Topics & Themes

**Highest-performing topics:**
1. **AI Agent architecture & capabilities** (14.2K views peak) — "Claude's source code leaked," agent fundamentals, autonomy vs. chatbots
2. **Claude/Anthropic product updates** (9.6K–14.2K views) — code capabilities, remote control features, security concerns
3. **Model Context Protocol (MCP)** (2.9K–2.6K views aggregated) — industry adoption, building custom servers, security vulnerabilities
4. **Data streaming & real-time systems** (1.5K–3.3K views) — practical tutorials on turning APIs/S3 into streams, Kafka alternatives
5. **AI cost optimization** (1.1K views) — open-weight models vs. proprietary, 20x cost savings narrative
6. **AI agents security & governance** (1.1K–1.4K views) — access control, data safety, enterprise readiness

**View correlation insight:** Breaking news/controversy (source code leak: 14.1K) and high-stakes concerns ("AI coming for your job," security holes) significantly outperform technical deep-dives. Explanatory content on industry standards (MCP, agents) performs moderately (2.6K–2.9K).

---

## Title & Hook Patterns

**High-performing patterns:**
- **Question + stakes/controversy:** "Claude Code's source code just got leaked" (14.1K views); "Is AI coming for your job? Yes… but let me explain" (2.2K)
- **Negative frame + resolution:** "The biggest AI models aren't always best" (5.5K); "Is MCP security a joke right now?" (1.1K)
- **Capability reveal:** "Claude can now control your entire computer" (4.2K); "Anthropic built the most powerful AI model ever — and you're not allowed to use it" (4.5K)
- **How-to + underexplored angle:** "Why did OpenAI buy OpenClaw?" (4.1K); "What are data streams?" (3.3K)
- **Contrarian takes:** "You're overpaying for AI by 20x" (1.1K); "Vibe coding" debate (9.4K with controversy in comments)

**Weak patterns:**
- Generic technical explanations without stakes ("What is an AI agent?" performs 2.6K vs. broader agent content at 14.1K)
- Event promotion without narrative hook ("Come say hello at AWS Summit": 1.4K)
- Hashtag-heavy, description-light titles (TikTok-only videos underperform without YouTube reach)

**Hook strategy:** Lead with **controversy, capability shift, or cost/job impact**. Then deliver counterintuitive insight ("but here's why..."). Avoid purely explanatory titles.

---

## Viewer Questions & Requests

**Security & governance concerns** (recurring):
- How to ensure agents don't access/exfiltrate data ("Who let AI steal my data?" comments focus on auth/policy)
- MCP attack vectors and enterprise readiness ("Is MCP security a joke right now?" — 3 critical vectors identified by Palo Alto Unit 42)
- Access control patterns across systems (OpenClaw worry: "one compromised step could compromise your entire stack")

**Skill/employment anxiety:**
- "If you don't actually know how to code, be prepared to lose your job if AI ever goes under" (vibe coding debate)
- Tension between democratization vs. security (detailed in comments: junior reliance on LLMs, but hype is shifting from skill to idea/design)

**Practical "how do I use this?" questions:**
- Building custom MCP servers ("It's easy to build your own MCP server" — clear demand signal)
- Real-time data patterns (data streaming, S3→stream conversion)
- Cost arbitrage: "How do I actually switch to open-weight models?" (implied in cost optimization videos)

**Product-specific requests:**
- Claude Code best practices ("3 things you should do with Claude Code" — 101–596 likes across platforms, comments ask for deeper tutorials)
- Knowledge base setup (comments ask implementation details)

**Meta-requests from comments:**
- More in-person/event content ("more scenes at the next one?")
- Practical demos over conceptual (high engagement on YouTube transcripts with step-by-step walkthroughs)

---

## Actionable Recommendations

### 1. **Prioritize breaking news + counterintuitive analysis over pure education**
   - Your leak/controversy videos (14.1K) outperform concept explainers by 5–7x. Create a monitoring system for major AI product announcements and security disclosures, then ship analysis within 48 hours with a contrarian angle ("Should they open source?" vs. just "Here's what happened").
   - Reserve educational series for YouTube playlists; lead social feeds with narrative-driven takes.

### 2. **Build a "Claude Code mastery" series leveraging the performance gap**
   - Single Claude tips video (1.5K) + debate video (9.4K) show audience appetite, but no cohesive tutorial series. Create 5–7 videos: "Claude.md patterns," "Plan mode workflows," "Debugging with remote control," "Integration with MCP servers." Package as YouTube playlist + LinkedIn carousel to capture the top-1%-user segment hungry for advanced tactics.

### 3. **Create security-first content on agentic AI governance**
   - Comments reveal anxiety about MCP attacks, OpenClaw access patterns, and agent permissions. Make this a weekly segment: "Governance corner" — real scenarios (e.g., "What happens when your agent gets compromised?"), policy patterns (auth → authorization → enforcement), compliance frameworks (EU AI Act deadline Aug 2026 — only 1.1K views, but high strategic relevance).
   - Format: 60–90 seconds on TikTok/YouTube Shorts + deep-dive (3–5 min) on YouTube.

### 4. **Repurpose technical tutorials (data streaming, MCP servers) with "why this matters" framing**
   - Your how-to transcripts are detailed, but titles are functional (1–1.5K views). Test: "Turn any API into a revenue stream" or "Why MCP servers are eating Kafka's lunch" — same script, narrative-driven title. A/B test titles across YouTube/TikTok to identify lift.
   - Include a 15-second "outcome" hook at the top: "AT&T cut costs 90% by doing this" before the tutorial.

### 5. **Shift posting strategy: daily on TikTok (breaking/takes), 2–3x/week on YouTube (deep-dives), weekly on LinkedIn (thought leadership)**
   - TikTok videos underperform on reach (9.6K peak) but drive engagement. Post short-form controversy/takes daily; repurpose best performers as YouTube Shorts. LinkedIn content (demos, case studies) sees 1K–1K views but different audience — position as enterprise/B2B thought leadership to differentiate from social viral content.
   - Establish a "news cycle" cadence: Monday breaking news take, Wednesday deep-dive tutorial, Friday "what people got wrong" response video.

---

**Quick win:** Repost your top 3 videos (leak, vibe coding debate, AI agents explainer) with revised titles emphasizing stakes/controversy, and track CTR lift over 2 weeks.
